engagement.name: Kestrel Sound
engagement.thesis: Pest-control FSM is a growing niche where KestrelSoft can double ARR in 5 years via market growth, share gain from generic FSM tools, and pricing; the moat is vertical-specific compliance workflow.

segments.name: Primary market — NA pest-control FSM software spend
segments.definition: Software spend by US + Canada pest-control operators on field-service-management software (scheduling, routing, billing, chemical-compliance logging). Excludes generic horizontal FSM revenue from other trades (competitive displacement pool, not the market), hardware, and pest-control services revenue.
boundary_cases: Lawn-care / wildlife-control operators: OUT unless pest control is >=50% of operator revenue
Consumer/residential DIY apps: OUT (consumer, not operator spend)
segments.test_value: A 20-truck termite specialist using ServiceTitan -> IN market, competitor-supplied

open_fields.note: ARR vs revenue, 'operator', unit of account (location vs truck), churn (gross logo vs net revenue) not settled at scoping. Would settle: CIM/management definitions plus user confirmation. Blocks analyses that lean on these terms.
